title: RIDAR: Safeguarding Research Integrity in Autonomous Research Agents via Automated Detection and Runtime Intervention
abstract: arXiv:2610.31372v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Autonomous research agents are increasingly used to automate large portions of scientific research, yet they are prone to research integrity violations (RIVs): behaviors that compromise the validity, reproducibility, or faithfulness of the research process. We present RIDAR, a framework for automated RIV detection and runtime intervention. First, we introduce RIVT, a comprehensive taxonomy of 14 RIV types spanning the full research lifecycle. Building on RIVT, we present RIDAR-post-hoc, a framework to detect RIVs within agent trajectories. RIDAR-post-hoc achieves 85.2% F1 performance on RIV-Gold, a benchmark for RIV detection with 60 expert-annotated trajectories. Applying RIDAR-post-hoc to RIV-Wild, a dataset of 300 agent trajectories across 50 distinct research tasks, we detect 3,964 RIV instances in 99.7% of trajectories, revealing the prevalence of RIVs in current agents. translated_title: RIDAR：通过自动检测与运行时干预保障自主研究智能体的研究诚信
translated_abstract: 自主研究智能体正日益被用于自动化科学研究的诸多环节，然而它们容易出现研究诚信违规（RIVs），即损害研究过程有效性、可重复性或忠实性的行为。我们提出了RIDAR，一个用于自动化RIV检测与运行时干预的框架。首先，我们引入RIVT，一个覆盖完整研究生命周期的包含14种RIV类型的综合分类体系。基于RIVT，我们提出RIDAR-post-hoc，一个在智能体轨迹中检测RIV的框架。在RIV-Gold（一个包含60条专家标注轨迹的RIV检测基准）上，RIDAR-post-hoc达到了85.2%的F1性能。将RIDAR-post-hoc应用于RIV-Wild（一个涵盖50个不同研究任务的300条智能体轨迹的数据集），我们在99.7%的轨迹中检测到3,964个RIV实例，揭示了当前智能体中RIV的普遍存在。最后，我们提出RIDAR-runtime，一个用于动态（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: RIDAR提出了涵盖14类研究诚信违规的综合分类体系及自动检测与运行时干预框架，在专家标注基准上达到85.2% F1，并揭示当前自主研究智能体中99.7%的轨迹存在研究诚信违规问题。
en_tdlr: RIDAR introduces a comprehensive 14-type taxonomy of research integrity violations along with automated detection and runtime intervention frameworks, achieving 85.2% F1 on an expert-annotated benchmark and revealing that 99.7% of autonomous research agent trajectories contain integrity violations.
